understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate the grid and complete every level by entering each goal cell while the carried piece’s shape, color, and rotation exactly matched the goal’s requirements.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement changes position and consumes stamina, while blocked moves still consume stamina. Shape modifiers cycle the piece’s shape, color modifiers cycle its color, and rotation modifiers rotate it 90 degrees clockwise. A goal is completed only when all three attributes match simultaneously upon stepping onto it. Running out of stamina costs a life and resets stamina; losing all lives ends the game. In this episode, the piece needed rotation 0° but had 270°, and the required rotation changer was at [19, 30].
